correctStatements.text: At 09:30 jun reported users bouncing between the app and the login screen.
At 09:34 kai reproduced the redirect loop in a private window.
The session cookie was set for the old domain so the app never saw it after login.
The cookie domain setting was missing from the domain change checklist.
At 09:52 mara prepared a config change with the new cookie domain.
At 10:08 kai deployed the config to the first region.
At 10:24 mara finished the second region and saw the redirect errors stop.
Sign in was broken for roughly 40 minutes for anyone who tried between 09:00 and 10:15.
Mara will add the cookie domain to the domain change checklist.
